title: Leaders
source: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-history.md, reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leaders.md; ghidra/project.json CLeader::LoadKey (0x17F800), CWarHistory::LoadKey (0x1FC400), CLeaderHistory::LoadEntry (0x1FC4E0)

file.desc: one block per leader, keyed by the leader's id. What reads this level has not been read; every file in the mod and the base game has this shape

patterns.desc: a leader, keyed by his id - the number an order of battle's `leader` names

skill.desc: his skill: a floor, raised to what his experience earns (CLeader::PostLoad)

max_skill.desc: the highest skill he can reach

add_trait.desc: gives him a trait from common/traits.txt

history.desc: his career: dated blocks of rank and the rest

rank.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

id.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

experience.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

current_experience.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

gainable_trait.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

trait.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it: the loader takes it, but there is no reason to write it by hand

history.desc: CWarHistory::LoadKey, which a leader's history shares: dates only. A key that is not a number is ignored outright

patterns.desc: applied on that date. A leader whose history gives no `rank` is never put in service

rank.desc: his rank from that date; applying it takes a land leader off his unit

skill.desc: read and kept, and does nothing: CSkillChange's apply is an empty stub in this build (FINDINGS-history.md section 2)

add_trait.desc: gives him a trait on that date

remove_trait.desc: takes a trait off him on that date
